History

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the date, exercise, sets, reps and weight.
  2. Click Log Set — repeat for each exercise.
  3. Review your history newest-first with per-entry volume.
  4. Delete entries you logged by mistake.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I log a workout?

Pick the date, enter the exercise name, sets, reps and weight, then click Log Set.

What counts as one entry?

Each entry is one exercise with its sets/reps/weight. Add one entry per exercise you do.

What is the volume stat?

The history lists every entry newest-first, with volume (sets × reps × weight) computed per entry.

Where are my workouts stored?

In this browser's localStorage — private to this device.
